subject: Copywriting
title: Make America Great Again
description: A fast breakdown of Make America Great Again for builders.

hook.text: Reagan first used 'Let's Make America Great Again' in 1980. Trump shortened it and trademarked it in 2012.

buildup.text: The slogan implies something was lost and can be recovered. Nostalgia plus action—a potent emotional formula.

discovery.text: MAGA worked as an acronym, a hashtag, and a hat. It was designed for every medium simultaneously.

twist.text: Critics argued 'again' implied regression. Supporters heard 'restoration.' Same word, opposite readings.

climax.text: Four words dominated global politics for a decade. No slogan since has achieved the same cultural saturation.

punchline.text: Four words, trademarked. Slogans can reshape nations.

quiz.question: Who first used a version of 'Make America Great Again'?
